scope: Generation and packaging only. Viewed all sixteen existing eligible role looks before generation, accepted v6a/v6b style, all 112 normalized poses, fourteen source sheets, all 56 authored contact overlays, fourteen south-facing chair proofs, seven existing/new role sheets, all 285 catalog looks and twenty-eight nearest-comparison boards. Worker QA only; manager acceptance pending.
styleAssessment: Compact v6a/v6b head/body proportions, outlined cel shading, restrained gradients, coherent cardinal profiles, legible uniform blocks, upright arms-down standing and chair-free seated poses. Imaging olive/sage; phlebotomy graphite/sage; laboratory plum or sage without coat/cap; surgeon teal/blue with caps; OR nurse sage/steel blue and cream waist cord without cap; pharmacist white coat; repair terracotta/olive jacket, cargo trousers and work boots. Two glasses identities (14.3%), no gray-curls-plus-glasses designs, no logos or readable badge text. All fourteen reviewed at native 160x320 frame size and in actual runtime chair geometry.
limitations: 005's corrected source uses slightly flatter cel shading than the other thirteen; proportions, role colour, outline and pose continuity remain coherent on the final comparison sheets.

008 navy colour issue is resolved by the manager-requested deterministic measured RGB correction. Original native sheets remain bright blue and immutable; all eight packaged poses use navy. New correction proof requires manager verification.

003 shares the general braid-and-glasses motif with an existing perioperative nurse, but has graphite phlebotomy clothes, a different face/fringe, green rectangular frames and lighter skin. Whole-catalog comparison and visual review found no near-duplicate.
Contacts are independently authored worker candidates, not manager/root acceptance. E/W/N overlays are supplied; chair proofs use only the authentic south-facing Front Desk fixture, as in v5.

Native extraction preserves imperceptible alpha-1 edge noise: 9 poses have alpha-1 source footprint outside the canvas; 7 derived poses have alpha-1 border pixels. No alpha >=13 clipping. No thresholding, erasing or repainting was applied.

Browser gallery validation was deliberately not run and belongs to the manager. No runtime integration, approval, publication or Git backup is claimed. No game origin, browser profile or campaign storage changed.
